surface: Not Human Search production homepage and populated search
audience: humans evaluating agent-ready APIs and services
primary_conversion: free search to relevant result detail to a later verified provider action
conversion_quality_metric: provider-accepted action rate when the provider pilot exists

measured: The synthetic post-deploy smoke suite passed 39 of 39 checks.
Unauthenticated REST and MCP search both returned free results and committed query-free receipts.
A provider report remained at zero real Razorpay receipts after multiple synthetic Razorpay searches and reported synthetic_excluded true.
True mobile emulation measured inner, document, body, and client widths at 390 CSS pixels.
standards: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and keyboard-operability target.
Organic score and order cannot be purchased.
Canonical provider links stay directly available.
observed_patterns: The first screen leads with the query and relevant filters.
Result cards expose domain, description, readiness score, signals, and missing signals.
The optional score-owner actions are secondary to search.
hypotheses: Free discovery will produce decision-useful search and detail-selection behavior.
Thresholded provider demand and verified action receipts will be valuable enough for providers to fund.

review.first_screen: pass: value proposition, free-search promise, query, submit action, and index scale are visible
review.decision_path: pass: query to neutral comparison to detail receipt is direct
review.trust: pass: copy states organic rank is based on readiness and never payment; result cards explain score inputs
review.copy: pass: no subscription wall or unlock language remains in discovery
review.responsive: pass: desktop and true 390-pixel mobile states were inspected with no horizontal overflow
review.accessibility: pass for scoped source and visual review: explicit search label and help text, minimum 44-pixel mobile submit target, visible input focus border, semantic result links, and sufficient tested color contrast
